rationale: The stock gapped up to $19.00 on earnings and has already faded over 15% from its $19.94 high to sit near the bottom of its intraday range ($16.89 vs $16.59 low) and below the prior close ($16.99). Shorting here chases an extended move into prior-day support with wide spreads (41.4 bps) and drying 1-minute volume, while going long lacks any reversal confirmation against heavy overhead supply below both the 5-minute 9-EMA ($17.14) and VWAP ($17.74).
